focus: angr decompiler front/middle pipeline (Decompiler, Clinic, SSA, variable recovery, structuring, and their feedback loops)

pipeline.name: Cache Lookup
pipeline.description: Check if a cached decompilation result exists for this function with matching parameters (cfg, variable_kb, options, optimization_passes, etc.). If cache hit, extract codegen/clinic/ite_exprs/binop_operators and skip to type refinement.

pipeline.name: Global Variables Setup
pipeline.description: Populate kb.variables['global'] with symbol information from loader (name, address, size) to enable later recognition of global memory accesses.

pipeline.name: Clinic Invocation (AIL Conversion & Intermediate Stages)
pipeline.description: Core decompilation stage that converts CFG to AIL, applies two-level SSA, callsite construction, variable recovery, and type inference. This is the longest stage and calls many sub-stages internally.
pipeline.inputs: func (Function), cfg (CFGModel), kb (KnowledgeBase), optimization_passes, variable_kb, options

pipeline.name: Clinic Detailed Sub-Stages (Sequential)
pipeline.description: Clinic._decompilation_simplifications() executes 14 stages in strict order: return sites, argument list, stack pointer tracking, SSA Level0, constant propagation, callsites, pre-SSA-L1 simplifications, SSA Level1, post-SSA-L1 simplifications, variable recovery, semantic naming, externs collection.
pipeline.inputs: AIL graph from prior stage, reaching definitions, stack pointer info
pipeline.outputs: _ail_graph with SSA form, arg_vvars, variable_kb, vvar_to_vvar mapping

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 1: Make Return Sites
pipeline.description: Add return value expressions to Return statements based on function prototype and calling convention. Simplify graph afterward.
pipeline.outputs: _ail_graph with ret_exprs populated in Return statements

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 2: Make Argument List
pipeline.description: Recover function arguments from calling convention and prototype. Create virtual variable (vvar) mappings for each argument.
pipeline.outputs: arg_list (list of SimVariable), arg_vvars (dict of vvar->SimVariable mappings)

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 3: Track Stack Pointers
pipeline.description: Run StackPointerTracker analysis to determine stack offset at every instruction. Required before SSA Level1.

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 4: Pre-SSA Level0 Fixups
pipeline.description: Duplicate orphaned conditional jumps, rewrite jmp_rax calls. Prepares graph for first SSA transformation.

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 5: SSA Level0 (Register-Only)
pipeline.description: Transform AIL graph to partial-SSA form for register variables. Creates phi expressions for register definitions at join points. Does NOT convert stack variables.
pipeline.outputs: _ail_graph in SSA Level0 form (register phi nodes inserted)

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 6: Constant Propagation
pipeline.description: Run single-pass simplification with only_consts=True to fold constants and propagate constant values through expressions.

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 7: Pre-SSA Level1 Simplifications
pipeline.description: Block simplification (dead assignment elimination, copy propagation), simplify-function (multiple passes), and first callsite construction to identify stack arguments.

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 8: SSA Level1 (Stack Variables)
pipeline.description: Transform stack variables (identified via stack pointer tracking) to SSA form. Creates phi expressions for stack definitions. Runs simplification passes after SSA insertion.
pipeline.inputs: _ail_graph (SSA Level0), func_args, stack pointer offsets from _spt

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 9: Post-SSA Level1 Simplifications
pipeline.description: Four consecutive _simplify_function calls with unify_variables=True, narrow_expressions=True. Interspersed with optimization passes. Creates vvar_to_vvar dephi mapping.
pipeline.outputs: _ail_graph fully simplified, vvar_to_vvar mapping for dephication, arg_list rebuilt

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 10: Recover Variables
pipeline.description: Run VariableRecoveryFast on SSA AIL graph to identify variable boundaries. Run Typehoon type inference. Link variable annotations back to AIL expressions.
pipeline.outputs: variable_kb with unified variables, types, and variable-to-atom linkage

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 11: Semantic Variable Naming
pipeline.description: Apply semantic-based patterns to rename variables according to usage context (e.g., input buffers, output buffers, counters).

pipeline.name: Clinic Stage 12: Collect Externs
pipeline.description: Identify external memory locations (global pointers, extern globals) referenced by the function.

pipeline.name: Graph Simplification Passes (Before Region ID)
pipeline.description: Run OptimizationPass instances with STAGE==BEFORE_REGION_IDENTIFICATION. These passes can modify blocks but not graph topology. Output becomes input to RegionIdentifier.

pipeline.name: Region Identification
pipeline.description: Identify single-entry-single-exit regions (SEXEs) recursively from CFG. Creates hierarchical GraphRegion tree. May modify jump targets to create new artificial blocks for loop refinement.

pipeline.name: Region Simplification Passes (During Region ID)
pipeline.description: Run OptimizationPass instances with STAGE==DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION. After each pass, if graph modified, re-run RegionIdentifier on new graph. Includes jump table recovery, cross-jump revertion, etc.

pipeline.name: Save AIL Graph Before Structuring
pipeline.description: Create a copy of clinic.graph to clinic.cc_graph (Clinic-CodeGen graph) before structuring removes non-critical edges. This copy is used for reference in codegen.

pipeline.name: Structuring (RecursiveStructurer)
pipeline.description: Apply recursive schema-based structuring algorithm to convert regions into structured IR (if/while/for/sequences). Output is seq_node (SequenceNode tree).
pipeline.inputs: region_identifier.region, ConditionProcessor, function info, structurer options

pipeline.name: Region Simplification (RegionSimplifier)
pipeline.description: Simplify structured regions: merge sequences, remove unnecessary gotos, simplify if-else patterns (unless Rust flavor).
pipeline.inputs: seq_node (from structurer), ail_manager, variable manager, arg_vvars

pipeline.name: Post-Structuring Simplification Passes
pipeline.description: Run OptimizationPass instances with STAGE==AFTER_STRUCTURING on seq_node. Can modify seq_node in place.

pipeline.name: SSA-to-Non-SSA Transformation (Dephication)
pipeline.description: Remove phi expressions from seq_node by replacing phi variables with their source variables using vvar_to_vvar mapping. Produces non-SSA seq_node.
pipeline.inputs: seq_node (SSA form), vvar_to_vvar mapping from Clinic

pipeline.name: Memory Data Reference Discovery
pipeline.description: Walk seq_node to extract all Const expressions, check if they are valid memory addresses, and register them as data references in cfg.memory_data.
pipeline.outputs: cfg.memory_data updated with discovered data references

pipeline.name: Code Generation (CStructuredCodeGenerator or RustStructuredCodeGenerator)
pipeline.description: Convert seq_node and variable_kb into C or Rust source code. Generates function signature, body, and comments. Output is codegen.text.
pipeline.inputs: seq_node, clinic.arg_list, variable_kb, cfg (for comments), function, options

pipeline.name: LLM Refinement (Optional)
pipeline.description: If llm_refine option enabled, use LLM client to suggest improved variable names, function names, variable types, and function summary. Regenerates codegen.text if changes made.

pipeline.name: Cache Update
pipeline.description: Store result (codegen, clinic, type constraints, etc.) in cache and kb.decompilations dict for future reuse.

feedback_loops.name: cache_invalidation_on_failed_decompile
feedback_loops.trigger: self.errors is non-empty after first _decompile() attempt
feedback_loops.mechanism: Exception handler wraps initial _decompile in try/except, clears errors, switches preset, calls _decompile() again at line 219

feedback_loops.name: region_id_re_execution_on_graph_modification
feedback_loops.trigger: Optimization pass returns out_graph != None during _run_region_simplification_passes
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: _recover_regions to recompute region hierarchy for new graph
feedback_loops.mechanism: After each DURING_REGION_IDENTIFICATION pass, if out_graph exists, rebuild addr_and_idx_to_blocks, call _recover_regions (line 657), recompute RI

feedback_loops.name: simplification_fixed_point_in_block_simplifier
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Loop start in BlockSimplifier._analyze, re-run _simplify_block_once on modified block
feedback_loops.mechanism: while True loop with break condition new_block == block; caches cleared on change; max iterations=30 (ctr)

feedback_loops.name: ail_simplifier_iteration_until_convergence
feedback_loops.trigger: Simplification pass modifies AIL graph (expressions/statements changed)
feedback_loops.mechanism: AILSimplifier._simplify_function has iteration logic; BlockSimplifier called multiple times for each block

feedback_loops.name: calling_convention_refinement_via_callsite_analysis
feedback_loops.trigger: Callee function has no calling convention or prototype (case 4 in _recover_calling_conventions)
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: After initial CallingConvention analysis, if successful, result cached in kb.callsite_prototypes; if AIL func_graph provided, may re-patch AIL call statements with ret_expr
feedback_loops.mechanism: Loop through all transition graph nodes, attempt CallingConvention analysis, update callsite prototypes or function prototype/CC

feedback_loops.name: prototype_recomputation_when_missing_or_guessed
feedback_loops.trigger: Decompiler._decompile sees that function.prototype is None or stale after Clinic runs
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Clinic re-runs (via _regen_clinic or cache miss) which calls _recover_calling_conventions and _make_function_prototype
feedback_loops.mechanism: Line 321 checks if regen_clinic OR old_clinic is None OR func.prototype is None; if any true, create new Clinic

feedback_loops.name: vvar_id_allocation_across_inlining_and_ssailification
feedback_loops.trigger: Inline call completes with new vvar IDs from callee Clinic; SSA transformation needs unique IDs
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Ssailification uses vvar_id_start from Clinic.vvar_id_start (updated by inline) to allocate phi IDs without conflict
feedback_loops.mechanism: callee_clinic.vvar_id_start updated after inline (line 554), passed to Ssailification (indirectly via clinic's state); no explicit rewind but ID space preserved

feedback_loops.name: dephi_mapping_validation_and_update_in_dephication
feedback_loops.trigger: DephicationBase._collect_and_remap finds phi assignments and builds vvar_to_vvar mapping; if mapping already provided, uses it directly
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: If rewrite=True, GraphRewritingAnalysis applies mapping by rewriting vvars in all statements
feedback_loops.mechanism: Fixed-point iteration in _collect_and_remap (lines 55-69) until convergence on transitive phi relationships

feedback_loops.name: type_inference_constraint_collection_and_resolution
feedback_loops.trigger: VariableRecoveryFast collects type constraints from AIL graph; Typehoon solves them; if constraints exceed threshold or solver fails, fallback to default types
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: No explicit rewind; on Typehoon exception, types remain unrefined (fallback to SimTypeBottom); on threshold exceeded, skip Typehoon entirely
feedback_loops.mechanism: Try-catch in _recover_and_link_variables (lines 2313-2361); if exception, log warning and continue without type info

feedback_loops.name: variable_unification_and_liveness_merge
feedback_loops.trigger: Variable recovery completes, VariableRecoveryFast produces variable_manager with SSA vars; liveness analysis determines which vars interfere
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: var_manager.unify_variables called with interference graph from SLivenessAnalysis; merges SSA vars into unified vars
feedback_loops.mechanism: One-pass unification after liveness (no iteration); affects variable names assigned in subsequent codegen

feedback_loops.name: optimization_pass_stage_filtering_and_reorder
feedback_loops.trigger: Decompiler._run_graph_simplification_passes or _run_region_simplification_passes iterates through self._optimization_passes and filters by STAGE
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Each pass can return out_graph != None, triggering re-build of block maps and re-execution of RegionIdentifier
feedback_loops.mechanism: For-loop over passes, skip if STAGE != current; if pass returns out_graph, re-run RI; otherwise proceed to next pass

feedback_loops.name: cache_reuse_with_prototype_invalidation
feedback_loops.trigger: Cache hit occurs but function.prototype changed since cache was created
feedback_loops.rewinds_to: Clinic.copy_graph() called to reuse old graph, but prototype comparison may cause re-analysis if prototype source changed
feedback_loops.mechanism: Line 357-358 restores cc_graph from cache; no explicit re-run, but downstream code may detect prototype mismatch

decision_points.name: preset_selection
decision_points.decision: Which optimization passes to use - determined by selecting a DecompilationPreset (default, basic, etc.) or explicitly providing a custom set. The preset dictates which optimization passes and their configurations get applied throughout the pipeline.
decision_points.alternatives: Different preset would mean different optimization passes run - e.g., 'basic' fallback runs if initial decompilation fails, resulting in simpler transformations and potentially different output
decision_points.current_override: explicit preset parameter, options system via DecompilationOption

decision_points.name: clinic_regen_decision
decision_points.decision: Whether to regenerate the Clinic analysis or reuse cached results. If _regen_clinic=False and cache exists with valid prototype, old clinic is reused.
decision_points.alternatives: Not regenerating means stale prototype or arg_list from previous run could be used; regenerating means expensive re-analysis but guarantees fresh results

decision_points.name: cache_hit_determination
decision_points.decision: Whether to use cached decompilation result based on _cache_parameters matching stored cache.parameters. Affects whether entire Clinic stage is skipped.
decision_points.alternatives: Cache miss forces full Clinic re-run; cache hit reuses codegen/clinic with ite_exprs/binop_operators optionally overridden
decision_points.current_override: use_cache and update_cache parameters; _can_use_decompilation_cache checks structural equality

decision_points.name: structurer_algorithm_selection
decision_points.decision: Which structuring algorithm to use (DEFAULT_STRUCTURER vs PhoenixStructurer) - affects loop handling, successor completion, and callexpr folding.
decision_points.alternatives: Phoenix vs Recursive structurer changes _force_loop_single_exit, _complete_successors, fold_callexprs_into_conditions settings, impacting final IR structure

decision_points.name: ssa_level_depth
decision_points.decision: Two-level SSA transformation strategy: Level0 (register only) then Level1 (stack variables). Whether to include intermediate passes between them.
decision_points.alternatives: Skipping SSA levels would lose register/stack aliasing analysis; different ordering would affect phi placement
decision_points.current_override: start_stage and end_stage parameters control which stages execute

decision_points.name: constant_propagation_timing
decision_points.decision: Constant propagation runs once after SSA Level0 with only_consts=True and max_iterations=1, vs skipping it or iterating until fixed point.
decision_points.alternatives: Skipping would lose constant folding opportunities; fixed-point iteration would be more expensive but more complete
decision_points.current_override: hardcoded as single pass with specific parameters, no option exposed

decision_points.name: callsite_construction_timing
decision_points.decision: Callsites are made twice: once before full SSA (to determine stack args), then again after SSA Level 1. Whether to make them at all.
decision_points.alternatives: Single callsite pass would miss variadic argument detection; skipping would lose calling convention recovery
decision_points.current_override: hardcoded as two-pass approach in stages; cannot skip

decision_points.name: stack_variable_ssa_after_sp_tracking
decision_points.decision: Stack pointer tracking must complete before SSA Level1 so that stack variable offsets are known for phi placement.
decision_points.alternatives: Reversing order would cause undefined stack variable offsets during SSA; skipping tracking would make SSA Level1 unusable
decision_points.current_override: stage ordering in _decompilation_simplifications loop enforces this

decision_points.name: simplification_iteration_strategy
decision_points.decision: Function is simplified 4 times in sequence (unify, narrow, etc. parameters toggled), with optimization passes between each. Fixed iteration count vs dynamic.
decision_points.alternatives: Single pass would miss transitive simplifications; dynamic fixed-point would be more expensive
decision_points.current_override: hardcoded as exactly 4 _simplify_function calls with specific parameters

decision_points.name: variable_recovery_entry_point
decision_points.decision: Variable recovery receives fully SSA-ified, simplified AIL graph and converts it to variable-level IR. Whether to run at all depends on _clinic_end_stage.
decision_points.alternatives: Skipping variable recovery loses variable names/types; running before SSA would cause inaccurate variable boundaries

decision_points.name: dephi_mapping_collection
decision_points.decision: After SSA completion, vvar_to_vvar dephi mapping is collected before variable recovery. This mapping is later used by dephication to remove phi variables.
decision_points.alternatives: Not collecting mapping would make dephication fail; collecting at wrong time would use stale SSA state
decision_points.current_override: hardcoded in stage execution order, no override available

decision_points.name: calling_convention_recovery_pre_ail
decision_points.decision: Calling conventions for all callee functions recovered before VEX->AIL conversion (unless pcode arch). If missing, recovered post-AIL.
decision_points.alternatives: Post-conversion only would cause inaccurate call site prototype resolution; skipping would use default calling conventions

decision_points.name: indirect_jump_and_tailcall_handling
decision_points.decision: Indirect jumps simplified to direct, tail jumps converted to tail calls, before graph simplification passes.
decision_points.alternatives: Not handling them would leave incorrect call/jump semantics; handling after simplification would interfere with simplifiers

decision_points.name: graph_modification_after_region_id
decision_points.decision: If optimization pass modifies graph, RegionIdentifier is re-run. If no mods, return existing RI.
decision_points.alternatives: Not re-running would use stale region info; always re-running would be expensive
decision_points.current_override: conditional check: if a.out_graph is not None, re-run RI

intervention_surfaces.name: Decompilation Preset
intervention_surfaces.description: DecompilationPreset (e.g., 'default', 'basic', 'full') determines which OptimizationPass instances and their parameters are selected. Presets are defined in decompilation_presets.py.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Decompiler._decompile -> _optimization_passes list, cascading to all optimization invocations

intervention_surfaces.name: Clinic Start/End/Skip Stages
intervention_surfaces.description: clinic_start_stage, clinic_end_stage, clinic_skip_stages parameters allow fine-grained control over which Clinic sub-stages execute. Useful for debugging or for decompilation-only-to-SSA use cases.

intervention_surfaces.name: Cache Control
intervention_surfaces.description: use_cache (default True) and update_cache (default True) control whether cache is checked and whether results are stored. Setting both to False forces full re-analysis.

intervention_surfaces.name: Structuring Algorithm Selection
intervention_surfaces.description: structurer_cls option allows selecting between DEFAULT_STRUCTURER (RecursiveStructurer) and PhoenixStructurer. PhoenixStructurer changes behavior of loop exit handling and callexpr folding.

intervention_surfaces.name: Optimization Passes
intervention_surfaces.description: optimization_passes parameter accepts list of OptimizationPass subclasses. Each pass has STAGE enum to determine when it runs. Custom passes can be injected or disabled.

intervention_surfaces.name: Variable Knowledge Base
intervention_surfaces.description: variable_kb parameter allows passing a pre-populated KnowledgeBase with existing variable types, manual renames, or constraints. If None, a fresh KB is created.

intervention_surfaces.name: Decompilation Options
intervention_surfaces.description: options parameter (list of (DecompilationOption, value) tuples) allows per-option configuration. Options are grouped by class (clinic, region_identifier, region_simplifier, codegen, decompiler) and passed as kwargs to respective analyses.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Decompiler.options_to_params -> cascades to Clinic, RegionIdentifier, RegionSimplifier, BaseStructuredCodeGenerator

intervention_surfaces.name: Flavor (Pseudocode vs Rust)
intervention_surfaces.description: flavor parameter selects language target: 'pseudocode' (C) or 'rust'. Rust flavor disables multi-statement expressions and simplifies if-else differently.

intervention_surfaces.name: Peephole Optimizations
intervention_surfaces.description: peephole_optimizations parameter allows custom peephole optimization rules to be injected into BlockSimplifier and AILSimplifier. Useful for arch-specific or domain-specific optimizations.

intervention_surfaces.name: Generate Code Flag
intervention_surfaces.description: generate_code parameter (default True). If False, skips structuring, dephication, and code generation. Useful when only AIL analysis is needed.

intervention_surfaces.name: AIL Collapse Depth
intervention_surfaces.description: expr_collapse_depth (default 16) controls depth limit for expression folding in code generation. Deeper expressions are collapsed to variables to avoid overly nested output.

intervention_surfaces.name: Inline Functions
intervention_surfaces.description: inline_functions parameter specifies a set of Function objects to inline during Clinic analysis. Inlining creates separate Clinic runs for each callee.

intervention_surfaces.name: Desired Variables
intervention_surfaces.description: desired_variables parameter limits variable recovery to a specific set of variable names. Useful for targeted analysis of specific variables.

intervention_surfaces.name: Reset Variable Names
intervention_surfaces.description: reset_variable_names (default False) forces variable recovery to regenerate all variable names instead of reusing existing names from variable_kb.

intervention_surfaces.name: Constrain Callee Prototypes
intervention_surfaces.description: constrain_callee_prototypes option (default False) enables type constraint generation from callee prototypes, refining caller's type inference.

intervention_surfaces.name: Decompilation Notes
intervention_surfaces.description: notes parameter (dict) allows external annotation of decompilation process. Stored in cache and accessible during structuring/codegen for debugging.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Stored in self.notes, passed to RegionIdentifier, RegionSimplifier, passed to codegen

intervention_surfaces.name: Static Virtual Variables and Buffers
intervention_surfaces.description: static_vvars and static_buffers allow pre-defining variable values for specific SSA locations, bypassing standard variable recovery for those locations.
intervention_surfaces.affects: Clinic._recover_and_link_variables, potential use in optimization passes

intervention_surfaces.name: Stack Pointer Tracker Memory Tracking
intervention_surfaces.description: sp_tracker_track_memory (default True) enables memory operation tracking in stack pointer analysis. Disabling reduces analysis scope but speeds up analysis.

intervention_surfaces.name: Type Constraint Degradation Threshold
intervention_surfaces.description: type_constraint_set_degradation_threshold (default 150) controls when Typehoon solver degrades constraint set complexity to avoid timeout. Lower values degrade earlier, reducing precision.

insights: The decompiler is NOT a strict compiler pipeline; it is driven by a series of internal decision points (preset selection, caching, structuring algorithm) and frequent feedback loops where later analysis triggers re-execution of earlier stages (region identification re-runs after optimization, type inference fallback, SSA fixed-point iterations). These feedback loops are the most consequential design decisions.

The Clinic analysis (which handles AIL conversion and SSA) is the longest stage and includes 12 sub-stages with subtle interdependencies: SSA Level0 must precede stack pointer tracking recognition, stack pointer tracking must precede SSA Level1, and variable recovery must follow complete SSA to accurately identify variable boundaries. The sub-stage ordering in Clinic._decompilation_simplifications() is strictly enforced and non-negotiable.

Caching operates at multiple levels: DecompilationCache stores entire codegen/clinic/type_constraints, while BlockCache (in AILSimplifier) caches ReachingDefinitions per block. Cache hits are validated by structural equality (_cache_parameters comparison), not identity, so parameter changes invalidate cache.

Optimization passes are architecturally separate from the main pipeline stages, but their STAGE enum determines injection points (BEFORE/DURING/AFTER RegionID, AFTER structuring, etc.). Passes that modify graphs trigger RegionIdentifier re-execution, creating explicit feedback loops. A single pass's modification can force re-analysis of all downstream stages.

Variable recovery is a critical juncture where SSA form is interpreted as variable-level IR. It depends on VariableRecoveryFast (which analyzes SSA vvar definitions), Typehoon (type constraint solver), and SLivenessAnalysis (to unify SSA vars). Failures in any of these fall back to default types (SimTypeBottom) with logging but no retry.

The interprocedural model is implemented via calling convention recovery (CallingConvention analysis and CompleteCallingConventions) which infers callee prototypes from call sites if unavailable. This happens twice: before AIL conversion (for non-pcode) and after (for pcode). Incorrect or missing callee prototypes degrade call site accuracy but do not trigger re-analysis of the caller.

Dephication (SSA-to-non-SSA) uses a vvar_to_vvar mapping computed in _stage_post_ssa_level1_simplifications before variable recovery runs. This mapping is fixed at that point and does not re-compute if variable recovery reveals additional phi variables. The mapping is conservative: it only maps phi varids to their source varids without re-analysis.

The expression narrowing step (AIL simplifier) is invoked once after callsite construction via narrow_expressions=True. This identifies unused high bits and masks them, reducing expression width. No fixed-point iteration occurs; a single pass is applied.

Semantic variable naming is an optional, non-essential stage (can be skipped via _skip_stages) that applies pattern-matching heuristics to rename variables (e.g., 'input_buffer', 'return_code'). It runs after variable unification and has no feedback to earlier stages.

The LLM refinement pass is the final stage and is optional. It regenerates codegen.text if any changes (variable renames, type changes) were made, but does not re-run any analysis. Type changes via LLM do not re-run Typehoon.
